nodes.relation: H075 extracts the exactly invertible degree-preserving part of the broad affine preprocessing in H072 and turns it into a bidirectional certificate-preservation lemma.
H076 reverses H071's desired preservation theorem and makes the auxiliary-variable escape route itself an explicit falsifiable construction problem.
H077 weakens H071 from arbitrary polynomially many local extensions to acyclic bounded-depth definitions, the smallest class for which a compositional substitution proof may work.
H078 salvages H074 by fixing one encoding, one finite monomial basis, one equality notion, and one explicit SAT/UNSAT family for each level.
H079 turns H070's known generic-reduction weakness into a quantified attack on all constant-radius graph gadgets rather than one fixed reduction.
H080 synthesizes the local graph barrier and extension-depth analysis into a disjunction of resources that every universal compiler must expose.
H081 narrows H070/H073 to a condition-number-aware certificate theorem rather than assuming every SDP optimum has a short exact witness.
H082 replaces H073's unbounded-level broad equivalence by one fixed-level Boolean specialization with explicit conditioning hypotheses.
H083 adds restriction robustness and separates harmless coordinate symmetries from Gaussian projection, making the target compatible with standard lower-bound induction techniques.
